citations.claim: At step 1227 body 1 sits exactly on waypoint 2 (7.135...,9.598...) with near-zero speed, one step before NaN
At first violating step 1228 body 1 position is non-finite (NaN) while other bodies remain finite

counterfactual.change: Moved second waypoint x from 7.13516 to 7.63516 (+0.5) so controlled body never sits exactly at zero distance to target; otherwise identical. Failure disappears.

explanation: Controller waypoint logic divides by distance-to-waypoint (to compute direction to target). At step 1227 body 1 is exactly on waypoint 2 with ~0 velocity, so distance is 0; next update computes 0/0 -> NaN force/velocity which propagates to position, energy and work at step 1228. Shifting the waypoint by 0.5 avoids the exact zero-distance case and removes the NaN.
vision_note: Through steps 1225 to 1227 a red body hovers motionless near the top while three blue bodies sit at the bottom. At step 1228 the red body vanishes entirely, revealing a green waypoint cross at its exact former position.
